Class PhysicsObject

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a game object with physics properties and simulation logic. Inherits from GameObject and adds velocity, mass, drag, and force/impulse accumulation.

public abstract class PhysicsObject : GameObject, IUpdateable, IDrawable

Remarks

PhysicsObject provides a simple physics simulation model for 2D games, including drag, momentum, and energy calculations.

Properties

AccumulatedForce

Gets the accumulated force to be applied on the next update.

public Vector2 AccumulatedForce { get; }

Property Value

Vector2

Remarks

Calling AddForce(Vector2) or AddForceRaw(Vector2) changes AccumulatedForce. Use this to add constant forces each frame. AccumulatedForce will be added to Velocity with delta time applied in the physics step.

AccumulatedImpulses

Gets the accumulated impulses to be applied on the next update.

public Vector2 AccumulatedImpulses { get; }

Property Value

Vector2

Remarks

Calling AddImpulse(Vector2) changes AccumulatedImpulses. AccumulatedImpulses are added as is to the Velocity in the physics step. Use this for one-time impulses, not for constant forces!.

ConstAcceleration

Gets or sets the constant acceleration applied every update (e.g., gravity).

public Vector2 ConstAcceleration { get; set; }

Property Value

Vector2

Gets the normalized direction of the current velocity vector.

Property Value

Vector2

CurVelocityMagnitude

Gets the magnitude (length) of the current velocity vector.

public float CurVelocityMagnitude { get; }

Property Value

float

CurVelocityMagnitudeSquared

Gets the squared magnitude of the current velocity vector.

public float CurVelocityMagnitudeSquared { get; }

Property Value

float

DragCoefficient

Gets or sets the drag coefficient (0-1).

  • 0 = no drag
  • 1 = full drag
public float DragCoefficient { get; set; }

float

Remarks

Determines the percentage of velocity lost per second.

Methods

AddForce(Vector2)

Adds a force to be applied on the next update.

public void AddForce(Vector2 force)

Parameters

force Vector2

The force vector to add. If mass is positive, divides force by mass.

Remarks

Uses this to add constant forces each frame. AccumulatedForce will be added to Velocity with delta time applied in the physics step.

AddForceRaw(Vector2)

Adds a force to be applied on the next update, without dividing by mass.

public void AddForceRaw(Vector2 force)

Parameters

force Vector2

The force vector to add.

Remarks

Use this to add constant forces each frame. AccumulatedForce will be added to Velocity with delta time applied in the physics step.

AddImpulse(Vector2)

Adds an impulse to be applied on the next update. If mass is positive, divides by mass.

public void AddImpulse(Vector2 force)

Parameters

force Vector2

The impulse vector to add.

Remarks

AccumulatedImpulses are added as is to the Velocity in the physics step. Use this for one-time impulses, not for constant forces!.
